text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Aah, aah, it's over already.
It's over, it's over.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Epi's always trying to drag me outside.
And I can't win in games against her either.
Impossible. Total scrub. It's so over-over-over~.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Now, now... It seems quite severe this time, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "In that case, Ruler. Would you like to play a game with some other people sometime soon?"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
UWOOOOOH! What was that just now?!
She totally turned it around in an instant?! So cooool...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh...! In chess, a 'sacrifice'
is actually an assassin's blade poised to take the king.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Luring the opponent into thinking they have the advantage, then playing just one single move!
The entire board collapses! The look on their face!
...So hype! This turn of events is way too hype...!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-san is known as
the "Ruler of the Board"... or so they call her.

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "‘Ruler of the Board’...! That sounds so cool...!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
“...... Ha!
You guys are exaggerating.”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: —I'm. So. BORED!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ruler is always playing games!
And lately she's been all buddy-buddy with the underclassmen too!
Boring, boring, boring!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh my, I see...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. ...Epi-san.
Are you interested in baking sweets at all?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! What wonderful decorations!
Wherever did you get such an idea...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because the "Voice of Destiny" told me to do this!
...Alright, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
You all look like you're having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Did that help resolve
Cesario-san's troubles a bit?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thanks to your bold twist, Epi,
new pastry ideas just keep popping up...♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“—It's done! Cesario, take a look!
This is the Epi-Special that makes the impossible possible!”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I can hardly tell which of us is the upperclassman.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
...Oh?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, my, everyone!
What brings you all here today?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"This morning, I heard the 'voice of destiny'!
It told me to go to Pisa! So here I am!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: I was dragged here by "this."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I peeked in and saw Ruler-senpai was here!
Senpai! Can I watch you play games again?!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Me too, me too!
Also, Ruler-senpai's super intense game from the other day! I drew a manga about it, so please read it!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
Alright, alright, one at a time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—In that case, I made some sweets,
so how about having some while we chat?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Cesario!
Could that be... the "Epi Special"?!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Taking inspiration from Epi's arrangement,
I tried making it with a new recipe.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
Let's eat! Right now!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
...Ah! And Pisa-san, this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My! How lovely...
Are you truly certain I may have this?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I heard that you like gemstones,
so I tried making some kohakuto amber candy.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...Just like the other day, too.
The fact that we can all have fun together regardless of grade
is undoubtedly thanks to you, Pisa-san."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
So, with renewed gratitude and respect,
please accept this.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu. If that is the case, then I gratefully accept. I will savor every bite.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Once we finish reading manga, let's all play a game!
Let's go outside!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"No way. Playing cards are fine, right?
Let's play Daifugo. Team match."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ehhー! Outside is better!
Pisa!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu.
Now then, what shall we do?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"—And that's about it.
It was a really fun day off."
choice_data_list: Do you often play with those kids?
Do you hang out with those kids a lot?
So which was it in the end, cards or going outside?
So, did you end up playing cards or going outside?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"—And that's about it.
It was a really fun day off."
choice_data_list: Do you often play with those kids?
Do you hang out with those kids a lot?
So which was it in the end, cards or going outside?
So, did you end up playing cards or going outside?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yes.
This incident was the catalyst.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Just the other day, we went shopping for the dorm together.
And we ended up hanging out a bit after, but..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
At that time, Epi-san dragged us along,
and we all took purikura together.
...It was so much fun, truly♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
In the end, I did both.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
After playing cards,
we grabbed some snacks and had a light picnic outside.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm currently planning our next outing, maybe somewhere a bit farther away.
...I'm really looking forward to it♪
